title: Image of God
story:
A sculptor once made a statue in the center of a city.

It was not just any statue.

It resembled the sculptor himself.

People walked by every day and admired it.

But over time, dust and damage began to cover it.

Some people stopped noticing its beauty.

One day, the sculptor returned.

He carefully cleaned the statue.

Restored its details.

And said,

“This reflects who I am.”

In life, people often forget their true identity.

Life’s pressures, mistakes, and comparisons cover their value.

But God created humanity in His own image.

He gave purpose, dignity, and responsibility.

And He calls us to reflect Him in the world.
life_lesson: You are created in God’s image with purpose, dignity, and authority.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for creating me in Your image.

Help me to remember my true identity in You.

Remove everything that hides Your reflection in my life.

Let me live with purpose and responsibility.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you sometimes forget your true identity in God?

What things in life have covered your sense of worth?

How can you reflect God more in your daily life?
verse:
So God created mankind in His own image,
in the image of God He created them;
male and female He created them.
God blessed them and said, 'Be fruitful and multiply; fill the earth and subdue it.'
